item.title: VTubing: How a Japanese Phenomenon Is Going Worldwide
item.description:
📝 Since Japan is where VTubing first took off, it’s not surprising that Japanese VTuber companies still dominate the industry. Usually they play video games while chatting with viewers, but they may also watch TV shows, share their backstory or lore, and collaborate with other VTubers. While Sakuraha and Amikoto can speak Japanese, they aren’t originally from Japan.
🔗 Read more: https://www.tokyodev.com/articles/vtubing-how-a-japanese-phenomenon-is-going-worldwide
